as_told.title: Governor Fife Symington admits seeing Phoenix Lights

plain: James Fox, a documentary filmmaker who investigates UFOs, says he broke the story of Fife Symington, the governor of Arizona, about the Phoenix Lights, a huge formation of lights that many people say they saw over Phoenix in 1997. According to Fox, Symington later admitted, about ten years on, that he too had seen it, and that as a former Air Force pilot he said the thing could not have been from here. Coming from a sitting governor, that would be a powerful witness to something unexplained.
